title: 第19章 陈稳初战霸气尽显第20章 连升九小境又一绝对天赋
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
这玩意就是天命涅槃液？
陈稳手一翻，十一滴呈琉璃状的液体悬浮在手中。
在这些液体中，他感觉到了强烈的力量波动，还有玄妙的道韵在流转着。
尤其是那滴紫色的涅槃液，那种道韵极其古老恐怖。
甚至，他都有一种感觉。
即使是另外六滴涅槃液所含的道韵加起来，都没有这滴紫色的强大。
“芍子姐，我这要怎么用？”
陈稳不由开口道。
“直接服用。”仙红芍淡淡道。
这么简单？
陈稳半信半疑地打量着。
最后还是将这一滴天命吞入了腹中。
虽然仙红芍不太靠谱。
但他还是选择相信一次。
当天命涅槃液入腹的一瞬间，一股浓郁的力量顿时炸开。
不过这药力温和而舒爽，像是天降甘霖一般，将他的身体内外洗礼了一遍。
同时间，他的混沌序列体爆发出九彩混沌光，一条条序列枷锁飞出，在半空中交叠，映照着各种古老的天地异象。
轰！
下一刻，陈稳周身大震，**冲出一团团气血波澜，气息跟着节节攀升。
最后虽然没有完成突破，但实力也有了明显的提升。

这……好东西啊。
待一切平复后，陈稳才眼睛大亮。
在还没有用天命涅槃液时，他便知道它可以用于解锁序列枷锁，以助混沌序列体成长。
但让他没有想到的是，这对于修为增长也有如此大的裨益。
就拿这次来说，完全可以抵得上他一个月的修炼成果了。
如果这天命涅槃液用之不尽的话，那他的修炼速度不就起飞了？
想到这，陈稳顿时眼睛发亮起来。
仙红芍悠悠道：“想法是不错，但别忘了你实力越强，后面所需的天命涅槃液也会越多。”
“这没事啊，反正天底下的天命之子多着呢。”陈稳轻笑道。
再来。
接而，陈稳没有再犹豫，一下子便将剩下的十滴涅槃液吞入腹中。
一瞬间，十滴涅槃液的力量在体内炸开。
有了第一滴的经验，这次陈稳吸收起涅槃液力量来，要轻车熟路太多了。
轰！
在陈稳将最后一点力量吸收时，境界的屏壁终于被打破了。
只见半空中的灵气在急速汇聚，并在剧烈地跳动着，像是沸腾了起白开水一样。
但这并不是终点。
咔嚓！
随着一阵崩碎声，陈稳体内的第一条序列枷锁终于松动了。
content_en:
Is this thing the Nirvana Liquid of Destiny?
Chen Wen turned his hand, and eleven drops of glass-like liquid were suspended in his hand.
In these liquids, he felt strong power fluctuations and mysterious Taoist rhyme flowing.
Especially that drop of purple nirvana liquid, the Taoist charm is extremely ancient and terrifying.
He even had a feeling.
Even if the Taoist rhymes contained in the other six drops of Nirvana liquid combined are not as powerful as this drop of purple.
"Sister Shaozi, how should I use this?"
Chen Wen couldn't help but say.
"Take it directly." Xianhongshao said calmly.
So simple?
Chen Wen looked at it doubtfully.
Finally, he swallowed this drop of destiny into his belly.
Although the fairy red peony root is not very reliable.
But he still chose to believe it once.
The moment the Destiny Nirvana Liquid entered his belly, a strong force exploded.
However, the power of this medicine was mild and refreshing, like rain falling from the sky, washing his body inside and out.
At the same time, his chaotic sequence body burst out with nine-color chaotic light, and sequence shackles flew out one after another, overlapping in mid-air, reflecting various ancient phenomena of heaven and earth.
boom!
The next moment, Chen Wen's whole body was shaken, and waves of energy and blood rushed out of his body, and his breath was rising steadily.
Although the breakthrough was not completed in the end, the strength was significantly improved.
This is... good stuff.
After everything calmed down, Chen Wen's eyes widened.
Before using the Destiny Nirvana Liquid, he knew that it could be used to unlock the shackles of the sequence to help the chaos sequence body grow.
But what he didn't expect was that it would be of such great benefit to his cultivation.
Take this time as an example, it is completely worth the results of his one month's training.
If this Destiny Nirvana Liquid is inexhaustible, wouldn't his cultivation speed take off?
Thinking of this, Chen Wen's eyes suddenly lit up.
Xian Hongshao said leisurely: "The idea is good, but don't forget that the stronger you are, the more Destiny Nirvana Liquid you will need later."
"It's okay, there are many children of destiny in the world anyway." Chen Wen chuckled.
Come again.
Then, without any further hesitation, Chen Wen swallowed the remaining ten drops of Nirvana Liquid into his belly.
In an instant, the power of ten drops of Nirvana liquid exploded in the body.
With the first drop of experience, this time Chen Wen absorbed the power of Nirvana Liquid, which was a lot of work.
boom!
When Chen Wen absorbed the last bit of power, the barrier of realm was finally broken.
I saw the spiritual energy in the air gathering rapidly and beating violently, like boiling water.
But this is not the end.
Click!
With a crashing sound, the first sequence shackles in Chen Wen's body finally loosened.
